reason: The README describes a DSH plugin primarily for connecting and managing external LLM Providers, including OAuth and API-key setup, model routing, optional vision fallback, and usage and cost analytics; its installer can replace the host on the same port and it handles provider credentials.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中连接和管理多种模型提供商，支持授权或 API 密钥配置、模型切换、可选视觉回退以及用量和成本分析。
summaries.en: Connect and manage multiple model providers in DeepSeek Harness with authorization or API-key setup, model switching, optional vision fallback, and usage and cost analytics.

capabilities: API-key and custom OpenAI-compatible Provider configuration
Optional vision fallback for text-only models
Cross-session token usage and cost analytics
Self-contained installation, upgrade, removal, and same-port host replacement
